choice-and-trap.deterministic_runway: The permission line remained on the shared interface: MARA VALE / PENDING. The ACCEPT control waited beneath it. Jonah’s next sequence remained ready; Mara still held the cooling tea.
choice-and-trap.extraction_policy: latest complete paragraph prefix inside 150-220 harness words that passes choice-and-trap gate and precedes any time jump

gift-and-complicity.deterministic_runway: “Fulcrum doesn’t give this to new fellows,” Livia said. She rotated the shared interface and opened DATA PERMISSIONS. A new line appeared: SCOPE—RAW TELEMETRY STREAM; EXPIRES—06:00; ASSIGNEE—MARA VALE; STATUS—PENDING. Jonah stopped typing and left both hands visible above the keys.
gift-and-complicity.extraction_policy: latest complete paragraph prefix inside 200-270 harness words that passes gift-and-complicity gate
